_doc: Motedis' Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20): a closed cast corner bracket for 20 mm B-type profiles (Bosch Rexroth's 6 mm slot), 18 mm each way, fixed with an M4 hammer nut and an M4x8 low-head cap screw on each leg. Sizes from Motedis' drawing; the screw's place along each leg is read off it; the price from its shop page.
name: fitting-motedis-bracket-20-b6

fitting_kind.rule: A corner bracket: one leg on each beam, a screw and slot nut through each
fitting_kind.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

series.rule: Made for 20 mm profiles of B type (6 mm slot)
series.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

slot.rule: Made for the 6 mm B-type slot: centring lugs on each leg key into it
slot.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

material.value: cast metal (Motedis names it metal; a closed, ribbed casting as drawn)
material.rule: What it is made of as Motedis names it, with the form its drawing shows
material.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6; Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BBR20-Drawing.pdf

thread.rule: The fixing set Motedis lists: 2 x hammer nut B-type slot 6 [M4] and 2 x DIN 7984 M4x8 screws
thread.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

screw_form.rule: DIN 7984 is a low-head socket cap screw; the kit draws an ISO 4762 cap head, which is taller, so the head stands higher than drawn and its length under the head is the same
screw_form.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

screw_length.rule: M4x8, as the fixing set lists
screw_length.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

screw_count.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6; Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BBR20-Drawing.pdf

nut_kind.rule: Hammer nuts (Hammermutter), turned in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_kind.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

leg.rule: Each leg 18 mm from the outside of the corner, dimensioned on the drawing

width.rule: Across the bracket: 18 mm, dimensioned on the drawing

thickness.rule: The wall under each screw head: 3.5 mm, dimensioned on the section

mount_hole_diameter.rule: Each leg's hole is a slot 5.2 mm wide (11 mm long), dimensioned on the drawing; the kit draws it as a round hole of its width

holes_b.rule: The screw on b's leg: the slotted hole's middle about 11 mm from the outside of the corner, on the leg's middle. Not dimensioned: read off the drawing between the 3.5 mm wall and the 18 mm leg's end

holes_a.rule: The screw on a's leg, as on b's

cost.rule: One bracket in a pack of 10: 3.60 EUR the pack with 20% VAT (3.00 EUR without), on the date checked. Screws and nuts are sold apart (about 0.05 and 0.17 EUR each with VAT)
cost.source: Motedis, Winkel 20 B-Typ Nut 6 (S6BBR20), product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Winkel-20-B-Typ-Nut-6

bending_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this cast bracket, its two hammer nuts tight, holds a beam's end against turning across its axis, its screws tight. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess for this kind of join (JOIN_STIFFNESS.bracket): the same figure a join with "fitting": "bought" gets, so choosing this set changes no stiffness until the joint rig measures it
bending_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it

twist_stiffness.rule: How stiffly this cast bracket, its two hammer nuts tight, holds a beam's end against twisting about its own axis. The maker gives no figure, so this is frames' working guess (JOIN_STIFFNESS.bracket): the same figure a join with "fitting": "bought" gets, so choosing this set changes no stiffness until the joint rig measures it
twist_stiffness.source: A working guess of @rulecad/frames, with no measurement or published figure behind it: the joint rig (issue 264) measures it and cad measured replaces it
